DomainControlResponse.description:
CONTRACT ONLY: not mounted on the production router (mounted in P4 at the earliest); implemented by D8P (handlers are real but only mounted in tests).

A Profile x exact-match domain control.

Matching is exact: `example.com` does not cover `sub.example.com`.
Settings are per Profile and never propagate to other Profiles or Accounts.

domain.description: Normalized domain (lowercase ASCII / IDNA A-label host, no scheme, port or wildcard).

revision.description:
Monotonic revision starting at 1, incremented on every change.
Send it back as `expected_revision` to update or delete safely.

DomainControlMode.description:
CONTRACT ONLY: not mounted on the production router (mounted in P4 at the earliest); implemented by D8P (handlers are real but only mounted in tests).

Treatment applied to every actor whose canonical actor-ID host equals the domain.

ProfileActorRef.description:
CONTRACT ONLY: not mounted on the production router (mounted in P4 at the earliest); handlers answer 501.

Reference to a follower or target actor, local or remote.

actor_url.description: Canonical ActivityPub actor ID (URL). Always present, for local and remote actors alike.

profile_id.description: Profile nanoid; present only when kind is `local`, absent for remote actors.

username.description: Profile username; null while the Profile has none (legacy Profiles). Set once, immutable.
